lines.text: VALDORSO COATINGS S.p.A.
Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Ref. LT-1995-118 28 November 1995
LABORATORY TEST REPORT LT-1995-118
Subject: livering of AF-12 (ref. DR-1995-031).
Samples: basic lead chromate CL-77 lots 95-07 (reference, no
complaints), 95-09, 95-10.
Free alkalinity (as PbO): lot 95-07 0.21 %; lot 95-09 0.92 %; lot 95-10
0.88 %. Supplier specification: max 0.30 %.
Accelerated storage at 40 °C: AF-12 made with lot 95-09 gels within 9
days. The same batch with 0.08 % ammonium chloride added at the
dispersion stage is still fluid after 12 weeks at 40 °C (viscosity
change below 10 %).
Interpretation: the excess free alkali in the September pigment lots
reacts with the alkyd and causes livering. Ammonium chloride
neutralises the excess alkali.
Recommendation: add 0.8 kg ammonium chloride per 1000 kg batch as a
corrective measure while the supplier brings the pigment back
within the 0.30 % specification. The effect of the added chloride on
corrosion protection must be watched.
Signature: E. Marchisio
